entities.name: New Phyrexia-Zhalfir Switch
entities.description: The cosmic event that ended the New Phyrexian Invasion by returning Zhalfir as a plane in New Phyrexia's place.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Dominarian land phased out by Teferi, returned as a self-contained pocket plane.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Phyrexian plane that was swapped out of the Multiverse and phased out of existence.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Intended Zhalfir to be the vanguard against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out Jamuraa and Shiv, winding up on Zhalfir later and welcoming Wrenn.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor who compleated planeswalkers and sent them to other worlds.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The Invasion Tree, instrument of New Phyrexia's invasion, bonded by Wrenn.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: Dryad planeswalker who bonded with Realmbreaker and pushed New Phyrexia into Zhalfir's knotted magic.

entities.name: Zhalfirins
entities.description: Army that dispatched the remaining praetors.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: Survivors taken in as refugees on Zhalfir.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Its five suns now orbit Zhalfir.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event during which the Zhalfiran time rift was closed without aligning to the phasing spell.

entities.name: Capennan angels
entities.description: Angels trapped on Zhalfir's side after the fight.

entities.name: Praetors
entities.description: Phyrexian leaders, the remaining three of whom were killed.

events.summary: Teferi casts a powerful phasing spell removing Jamuraa and Shiv (and thus Zhalfir) from existence.
events.quote: He cast a powerful phasing spell that removed Jamuraa and Shiv (and thus Zhalfir) from existence

events.summary: Teferi winds up on Zhalfir when the Temporal Anchor fails and concludes it became a pocket plane where time slowed.
events.quote: Teferi wound up on Zhalfir when the Temporal Anchor failed

events.summary: Wrenn bonds with Realmbreaker with Chandra and Koth's help and plans to find Teferi.
events.quote: The dryad planeswalker Wrenn bonded with Realmbreaker

events.summary: Wrenn reaches Zhalfir and is welcomed by Teferi.
Wrenn and Eight push New Phyrexia into the knotted magic holding Zhalfir so the army can land; the reinforcements dispatch the remaining three praetors.
events.quote: The reinforcements dispatched the remaining three praetors

events.summary: The allies evacuate; New Phyrexia replaces Zhalfir in the planar tangle and phases out of existence while Zhalfir returns to the Multiverse.
events.quote: New Phyrexia replaced Zhalfir in the planar tangle and phased out of existence, while Zhalfir returned to the Multiverse.

events.summary: Glistening oil is cut off from its source and the Phyrexian armies cease to function.
events.quote: Their armies abruptly ceased to function and crumpled to the ground.

relations.note: bonded with it, nicknamed it Eight
relations.quote: The dryad planeswalker Wrenn bonded with Realmbreaker

relations.note: phased it out with his spell
relations.quote: devised a plan to stay out of the war

relations.note: New Phyrexia's invasion defeated by Wrenn
relations.quote: Elesh Norn compleated planeswalkers and sent them to other worlds
